statement: The Runtime reads the account's stored nonce from the chain and never derives it, and refuses to sign any proof at stored + 1 (either author): the first signed proof of a new epoch takes nonce stored + 2 or higher, because a Right-authored proof at stored + 1 only ties the implicit proof and cannot outrank it. A counter in a dispute is at the nonce the newest co-signed frame of the epoch was signed at, the epoch's first nonce plus its slot less one, whichever side authored it: a slot is not a count of frames.
source: contracts-decisions.md R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE (Review B of PR 76, coordinator 09-30)
